parameters: doji_body_max_fraction (text p/q, 1 <= p <= q, no default)

policy.scope: descriptive geometry of one or two completed bars; the result is value + readiness + witnesses + reason and never a signal or a ranking
policy.ties: doji is inclusive (body/range <= threshold); inside bar is strict on both sides; engulfing needs opposite colours, a covering body and at least one strictly beyond side; zero-body bars have no colour
policy.zero_range: range 0 gives zero_denominator for the three fractions and doji; inside_bar and the engulfing outputs stay defined (false)
policy.no_policy: no default threshold, no named multi-bar patterns, no trend context, no volume filter

policy.swing: bar s is a swing high iff its high is strictly above the highs of the k bars before and the k bars after; a swing low mirrors with lows; ties never qualify
policy.confirmation: a swing at s is known only when bar s+k is complete, so at target t the newest confirmable swing is s = t-k: no future bar is read and no zero-lag swing exists
policy.lookback: candidates s = t-L+k .. t-k, all neighbours inside slots t-L..t; the most recent candidate wins; none is no_eligible_observations
policy.structural_context: the governed slot grid, declared coverage, session identity and adjustment basis of the R17 context; swing strength and lookback are config; none has a default

policy.time_base: elapsed seconds are the exact difference of the two bar end instants (ns / 10^9), not the nominal bar length
policy.trend: M adjacent non-overlapping windows of N bars ending at the target; window direction is the sign of close(end) - close(base); a flat window counts 0; the result is the signed sum in [-M, M]
policy.session_return: (C_t - O_0) / O_0 with O_0 the open of the first governed slot of the session and C_t the close of the target; defined for session_reset only
policy.actions: the library does not detect splits or other actions; the caller declares one adjustment basis for the whole series (TD10)

headers.scale: price_unit.scale (value is the exact coefficient divided by 10^scale)
headers.available_when: slots t-L..t READY (OHLC) and at least one confirmed swing high among candidates t-L+k..t-k

headers.scale: price_unit.scale (value is the exact coefficient divided by 10^scale)
headers.available_when: slots t-L..t READY (OHLC) and at least one confirmed swing low among candidates t-L+k..t-k
open of slot 0 and close of slot t READY (session_reset only)

header_order: lexicographic by feature id within the contract; each output has its own readiness and closure

all.contract: R17 chunked BAR delivery on the governed grid of the epoch (intraday bars of the target session for session_reset, daily bars for governed_history); one instrument; positive-volume bars carry positive coherent OHLC, zero-volume proven-empty bars carry null OHLC; a close-only delivery (columns=close) is legal and serves only the close-based technical outputs; completed bars only (end <= market cutoff); every row carries its original known_at, an optional revision id and the adjustment basis

reference_fact_schemas.note: none: the three producers read only the bars role and the R17 context (slots, coverage, session identity, adjustment basis)

mathematics.notation: target slot t (last delivered slot unless the fixture names an earlier target), epoch slots 0..t, bar i = (O_i, H_i, L_i, C_i, V_i) positive int64 coefficients at price_unit.scale; R = H-L, B = |C-O|, U = H-max(O,C), D = min(O,C)-L for the target bar
mathematics.body_fraction: B / R in [0,1]; R = 0 is zero_denominator
mathematics.upper_shadow_fraction: U / R; lower_shadow_fraction = D / R; body + upper + lower = 1 exactly when R > 0
mathematics.doji: B * q <= p * R for doji_body_max_fraction p/q (integer test, inclusive); R = 0 is zero_denominator
mathematics.inside_bar: H_t < H_(t-1) and L_t > L_(t-1) (both strict)
mathematics.engulfing_bullish: C_(t-1) < O_(t-1) and C_t > O_t and O_t <= C_(t-1) and C_t >= O_(t-1) and (O_t < C_(t-1) or C_t > O_(t-1))
mathematics.engulfing_bearish: C_(t-1) > O_(t-1) and C_t < O_t and O_t >= C_(t-1) and C_t <= O_(t-1) and (O_t > C_(t-1) or C_t < O_(t-1))
mathematics.swing_high_confirmed: s = t-k; H_s > H_i for every i in s-k..s+k, i != s; needs slots t-2k..t
mathematics.swing_low_confirmed: s = t-k; L_s < L_i for every i in s-k..s+k, i != s
mathematics.last_swing_price: scan s = t-k down to t-L+k; the first swing gives H_s / 10^scale (or L_s); needs slots t-L..t; none found is no_eligible_observations
mathematics.session_return_fraction: (C_t - O_0) / O_0; when t = 0 the single bar gives (C_0 - O_0) / O_0
mathematics.price_velocity: v_t = ((C_t - C_(t-1)) / C_(t-1)) / dt_t with dt_t = (end_t - end_(t-1)) / 10^9 seconds, exact rational
mathematics.momentum_acceleration: a_t = (v_t - v_(t-1)) / dt_t, where v_t uses dt_t and v_(t-1) uses its own dt_(t-1); needs closes t-2..t
mathematics.signed_trend_window_count: NORMATIVE (PO-1): M adjacent non-overlapping N-bar windows (window stride = N) ending at the target; window direction = sign of the completed-window close change; a flat window counts 0; result in [-M, M]; M=1 is one window (TD19, TD20). Formula: sum over j = 0..M-1 of sign(C_(t-jN) - C_(t-(j+1)N)); an integer in [-M, M]; needs closes t-MN..t and every slot in between READY (adjacent windows, no bridging). Rejected alternatives: sliding (overlapping) windows and half-counting flat windows are consumer policy and are not part of this catalogue version
mathematics.publication: float64 outputs are the exact rational correctly rounded once (Python float(Fraction) equals IEEE round-to-nearest-even); bool and int64 outputs are exact; price outputs divide the integer coefficient by 10^scale
mathematics.no_mathematics_of_policy: no rank, threshold other than the caller doji fraction, score, signal or recommendation

quality.rule: all applicable reasons retained in lexical order; status follows the first applicable reason in precedence; value is null exactly when the status is not available; available implies observed == expected; the retained list is alphabetical, not precedence order, which is why KA09, KA18 and KA27 list future_knowledge before unknown_availability (status is missing_input either way)
quality.counts: expected = number of slots the output requires (including slots before the epoch start); observed = READY required slots inside the epoch; insufficient_history is added when the first required slot precedes the epoch; there is no shrinking window and no bridging of a hole

evidence.limit: config evidence_limit 0..10000 truncates the witness list; a joint selection is per output in this contract's fixtures
evidence.order: target slot first, then the remaining required slots ascending; the two last_swing_*_price outputs list the located swing slot first, then the target, then the rest ascending; unavailable outputs emit none
evidence.row_id: slot:<i> with i the epoch slot index

mode_rule: known_at and reconstruction availability give identical results: the producer enforces knowledge from the original known_at_ns of every consumed bar in both modes

knowledge_readiness.K: K is the knowledge cutoff, distinct from the market cutoff C (the end of the last delivered slot); a bar is KNOWN iff its original known_at_ns is non-null and <= K (== K is known)
knowledge_readiness.revision: a correction is delivered as the one current version of the bar (identity key excludes the revision id) with the known_at of the correction; a correction known after K is future_knowledge and the original version is NOT used; delivering both versions is DUPLICATE (RF refusal); the I/O layer selects the version known at K, the library never picks between versions
knowledge_readiness.consumed_only: only slots an output requires are assessed; a null or late known_at on a slot no selected output reads has no effect (KA future_outside_window and future_after_target)
knowledge_readiness.partial_bar: a bar that has not completed at the market cutoff is never delivered as a row (BOUNDS) and a forming target slot yields future_market, never a value
knowledge_readiness.compact: ka maps to known_at_ns = K_ns - (100 - ka) seconds with K_ns = C_ns + 100 s; ka 100 is exactly K, 150 is 50 s after it, 50 is 50 s before it

wire_expansion.clock: slot i of session grids: start_ns = 1700000000000000000 + i*60e9, end = start + 60e9, session S1, instrument X; daily (governed_history) slots: end_ns = base + ends_s[i] seconds (default (i+1)*86400), start = end - 86400 s, session D<i>; the market cutoff C is the end of the last delivered slot
wire_expansion.wire_slot: {wire: {inst, ss, start, end, row, ka, basis}} replaces a compact slot by an explicit row (omitted fields take the default expansion); {row, ka, rev, versions} carries known_at, revision id and several versions of one identity; refusal recipes use them so that DUPLICATE, INVALID_ORDER, BOUNDS and INCONSISTENT_IDENTITY come from real values fed to the independent admission model

refusal_precedence.wire: cell types, row width and int64 range (INVALID_SCHEMA, OVERFLOW)
refusal_precedence.shared: validate_batch and require_compatible_inputs: DUPLICATE, INVALID_ORDER, BOUNDS, OHLC and volume INVALID_SCHEMA, rows delivered with coverage not declared (INVALID_SCHEMA, ruling E2: no default-to-complete), structural context not delivered (INVALID_SCHEMA)
refusal_precedence.config: parameter set, ranges, vocabularies and the E4 span check (INVALID_CONFIG), feature ids (UNKNOWN_FEATURE), price unit and currency (INVALID_UNIT), adjustment (UNSUPPORTED_ADJUSTMENT), capability (UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY)
refusal_precedence.identity: INCONSISTENT_IDENTITY: instrument, session, interval not a governed slot, adjustment basis differing from the config
refusal_precedence.rule: a refusal raises the code of the first stage, in this order, that has a fault; a row that fails an earlier stage is not evaluated by a later one; every refusal fixture is a single-fault recipe and the independent expander audits that exactly one (stage, code) pair fires

acceptance_rules.exact_float64: the exact rational is dyadic with numerator below 2^53: the float must equal it
acceptance_rules.exact_plus_zero: exact zero from exact arithmetic: the float must be +0.0
acceptance_rules.tolerance: abs(y - r) <= max(8*ulp(r), 1e-12*abs(r)) with r the fixture float64 (R17 numeric policy)

refused_definition: PO-3: for EF5 acceptance 'refused' means (a) a typed refusal, or (b) a result-level fail-closed outcome: a non-available status, value null, no witnesses and a reason code, never a substituted value or a silently dropped row. Missing or future known_at is (b) with the ESTABLISHED reason codes unknown_availability / future_knowledge under status missing_input (the PO ruling wrote 'missing_input', which is the status; EF3/EF4 and this contract keep the codes, so no code change is needed). A bar incomplete at the market cutoff is future_market, unavailable. KA-set and fail-closed drivers assert null value plus reason code; every output echoes the declared adjustment basis in the result field `basis` (PO-4; decision: a result field, not a witness, because witnesses are slot row ids; recorded in DECISIONS.md).

known_limits: TD10: the declared basis is trusted and no action facts are consumed; no split is detected (PO-4). EF6 may add action facts (a new optional REFERENCE role) that mark windows unavailable; non-breaking
elapsed_time: PO-6 normative: dt_k = (end_k - end_(k-1)) / 10^9 seconds from the supplied end instants (not nominal bar length); velocity divides by dt_t, acceleration is (v_t - v_(t-1)) / dt_t from the two successive velocities (each with its own dt); a missing end instant is INVALID_SCHEMA (wire, RF50) and a non-positive dt is refused by the shared validator (INVALID_ORDER RF51, BOUNDS); TD11 shows a 3-day weekend dt; under session_reset slot 0 is the first bar, has no velocity (a window reaching before it is insufficient_history) and no interval crosses the session boundary
fixture_notation: compact, NOT canonical wire. K = 100, default known_at 50, volume 5. A fixture lists slots 0..n-1 in epoch order; the target is the last slot unless `target` names an earlier index (later slots are delivered but must not matter). A slot is [O,H,L,C,V] (columns=ohlcv), [C] (columns=close), or 'absent' (no row, no coverage), 'gap' (no row, declared incomplete coverage), 'forming' (bar not complete at the market cutoff), 'null' (row with null volume and OHLC), 'empty' (zero volume, null OHLC, coverage complete), or {row, ka, rev} (ka 100 == K known, 150 > K, null unknown). Structure fixtures list H and L in the description; each slot is [L,H,L,H,5] (open at the low, close at the high). Technical fixtures build slot i from the previous close (slot 0 from the stated open) with H/L the max/min of open and close. `grid: daily` selects governed_history daily slots, `ends_s` their end offsets in seconds. hand_check states the hand-derived headline values. Result fixtures: CD (candle), SD (structure), TD (technical), KA (known_at set); refusals RF.

open_questions.text: confirm the signed completed-window trend count is M adjacent non-overlapping N-bar windows, direction = sign of the close change, flat window = 0, result in [-M, M]. Alternatives: sliding windows (overlapping), or flat counted as a half or excluded. The manifest operands (ordered_completed_close_windows, adjacency, session_reset) do not decide it.

E9 gives no squared form. Proposed fraction/s^2 for acceleration and `windows` for the trend count; the manifest units fraction_per_second and fraction_per_second_squared are recorded as aliases and replaced with fraction/s and fraction/s^2 in this PR.

the acceptance criterion says these are 'refused'. The EF3/EF4 contracts treat them as result-level fail-closed (missing_input, null value, reason unknown_availability or future_knowledge). Confirm that is 'refused' for EF5, or require a typed refusal (which would change a shared EF3/EF4 semantic).

v1 consumes one caller-declared adjustment basis and does not detect splits (TD10 computes -1/120 across a 2:1 drop on an unadjusted basis). Alternative: require supplied action facts (a REFERENCE role) and mark windows crossing an action unavailable. Which for v1?

accept the minimum catalogue (7 candle, 4 structure outputs) and the tie conventions (doji inclusive, inside bar strict, engulfing needs one strict side, swings strict). Is any named multi-bar pattern required for EF5 acceptance?
velocity and acceleration divide by the exact difference of bar end instants (a daily bar after a weekend uses 3 days: TD11). Alternative: nominal bar length. Proposed: actual end-instant difference.

EF5 uses INVALID_SCHEMA (matches the merged tape adapter); the EF4 library code for the same case is the one ruled in E2 and may differ (cross-reference in EF5_SHARED_AMENDMENT). INVALID_SCHEMA is used for rows without declared coverage, matching the merged tape adapter; E2 allowed any existing fitting code (INCONSISTENT_IDENTITY is the alternative).

layer_responsibilities.library: admission of supplied bars and context, slot readiness, exact arithmetic, quality, evidence and every library refusal; pure and deterministic; one shared slot table reused by outputs without coupling their readiness
layer_responsibilities.io: maps ordered bars, the governed grid, coverage, adjustment basis, original known_at and revision identities exactly as supplied; selects the version known at K; never sorts, fills, imputes, drops, resamples, converts, chooses a window or computes a pattern; the brief lists every default (expected: none)
layer_responsibilities.worker: routes selected outputs with exact window closure, executes a bounded pattern window without future data, preserves correction and replay scope, persists the library result unchanged; direct, adapter, worker and stored results are identical including refusal class
